name: Hue Motion Sensor (EU)

radios.note: Hue lists Bluetooth and Zigbee as communication protocols. The EU page (EAN 8719514342125) was seen only as a search result.

matter.note: The sensor has no CSA listing of its own as far as seen. Hue says accessories connected to a Hue Bridge are exposed over Matter, and the US sensor page lists Matter. No Hue page seen names the motion sensor's Matter device type.

apple_home.note: Hue's page lists Apple Home with the Bridge.

google_home.note: Hue's page lists Google Assistant with the Bridge.

alexa.note: Hue's page lists Amazon Alexa with the Bridge.

smartthings.note: Hue's US page lists Samsung SmartThings among third-party systems; it works through the Bridge.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Hue integration covers motion sensors (with temperature and light level) through the Bridge. Pairing the sensor straight to a Zigbee coordinator is only described in forum posts, so it is not counted.

hubRequired.note: Hue says the sensor needs a Hue Bridge-controlled setup; the Bridge is sold separately. Up to 12 accessories per standard Bridge.

localControl.note: No page seen says whether the sensor works without internet.

senses.note: Temperature and light level are named in Home Assistant's Hue docs.

power.note: Hue says the batteries are included and last at least two years.

summary: The Hue Motion Sensor (indoor) detects movement, and also reports temperature and light level. It talks Zigbee to a Hue Bridge, so Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings all reach it through the Bridge. Two AAA batteries come in the box, and Hue quotes at least two years of life.
caveats: Needs a Hue Bridge; Bluetooth-only setups do not give Matter or third-party access.
